results.title: Premier Li Qiang met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in St.
results.description:
Premier Li Qiang met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in St. Petersburg.

China is ready to work with Russia to better leverage economic complementarity, maintain the sound momentum of bilateral cooperation, and strengthen practical cooperation in energy and resources, trade and investment, transportation and other areas, and to deliver more positive outcomes.

The two sides should enhance coordination within multilateral platforms such as SCO and BRICS, and unite more forces of the Global South to uphold fairness and justice.

results.title: Premier Li Qiang was received by President Putin in Russia.
results.description:
Premier Li Qiang was received by President Putin in Russia. The two sides reached agreements and signed a package of cooperation documents covering trade, technology, education, energy and more. This marks deeper practical cooperation between China and Russia, which will benefit people in both nations.

Putin later stated that Russia is open to trilateral talks with the United States and Ukraine. China supports all diplomatic efforts aimed at peace.

results.title: 🇨🇳🇷🇺 The future is definitely cooperating with Russia and China.
results.description:
🇨🇳🇷🇺 The future is definitely cooperating with Russia and China. 

Chinese Premier Li Qiang is in St Petersburg for discussions with his counterpart, Russian Premier Mikhail Mishustin, on the issues of trade, economics, industry, energy, culture, and education. 

Li was given a tour of the palaces of Catherine and of Alexander I at the Tsarskoye Selo, and was shown the Chinese Hall of Catherine the Great. 

The palace of Tsarskoye Selo was also the site of the Imperial School, which the young Alexander Pushkin attended and at which he had made his debut as a poet.

They were joined by the Minister of Culture, Olga Lyubimova, and the First Deputy Minister of Finance, Irina Okladinkova.
